name: stubfrac
tagline: Day-count fractions with irregular stubs in exact rationals, plus a map of where conventions disagree
trendOrigin: Trend 4 (EU opening a door to Canada). Joining two markets means reconciling conventions that look alike but aren't: Canada's 'ACT/365 Canadian Bond' rule and Europe's 30E/360 vs 30E/360 ISDA are known traps when desks integrate. The project makes those differences explicit and testable.
